what: The 18 calibration cases where Claude Opus 5.5 disagreed with the by-eye label, re-read at full resolution (576x1280) with the full step history (the original by-eye labels came from review sheets at 220x489 with the last 2 history lines). Diagnostic only: it does not change the registered result (75/93, FAIL).
caveat: The by-eye labels and this re-reading were made by the coding assistant (also a Claude model), not by a human; the judge and the reader are not independent.

classes.label_wrong: the screen or history clearly contradicts the by-eye label; the judge is right
classes.strict_defensible: the goal literally asks for more than was done; the judge's strict reading is defensible
classes.judge_too_strict: the goal's deliverable is visible (search / go through / show progress); the judge demands an extra step
classes.ambiguous: the goal does not say what 'done' means here; either answer is defensible
